create_toc_extension: create a Python-Markdown TOC extension that auto-generates a table of contents from document headers
build_slugify_function: build a function that slugifies a string to make it URL friendly by removing special characters
nest_toc_tokens: nest a flat list of TOC tokens into a hierarchical tree structure with parent-child relationships
strip_html_tags: strip HTML tags and comments from a string and return the plain text content
render_inner_html: render the inner HTML of an etree element as a fully processed string with postprocessors applied
